name: v0.3.14 — Central GuacScore + GuacWizard engines · Stash gets FetchCard · scenario reports
releaseNotes:
• ONE central engine for GuacScore (web/src/lib/guacoscore.js) and GuacWizard (web/src/lib/wizardScore.js). Web imports directly; mobile calls /api/guacoscore + /api/guacwizard or runs the Dart port locally (fixture-validated). Three implementations collapsed to one source of truth.
• 20-scenario × 2-engine cross-platform test reports. PDF + HTML at /guacscore-scenario-report.pdf and /guacwizard-scenario-report.pdf — 53/53 + 34/34 assertions green across web + mobile.
• Stash gets the Fetch-style item card on mobile: image, urgency pill, store badge, inline 5★ rating, value chip, ⋮ menu opening the per-item bottom sheet with on-hand stepper + Best Prices web hunt + Share + Add-to-Smashlist.
• GuacScore parity fix on web: dashboard tile no longer mixes lifetime receipts with period-only bankBite. Detail page now filters payment-receipt rows before scoring. Boundary cutoff snapped to midnight so a noon visit doesn't include/exclude a 90-day-old receipt by the hour.
• Mobile dashboard tile + /guacanomics screen migrated off inline score math — both now delegate to services/guacoscore.dart, the centralized Dart engine.
